players.bio: Alejandro Balde Martínez (born 18 October 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team. Known for his dribbling, pace, ball carrying abilities and defensive contributions he is considered one of the best left-backs in the world.

Andreas Bødtker Christensen (Danish pronunciation: ; born 10 April 1996) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Barcelona and the Denmark national team. Christensen began his career at Skjold Birkerød and later joined Brøndby. He joined Chelsea at the age of 15 in February 2012, making his professional debut in October 2014.

Anthony Michael Gordon (born 24 February 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays primarily as a winger for La Liga club Barcelona and the England national team. Gordon began his professional career with Everton, making his senior debut in December 2017 in a Europa League match, before joining Newcastle United in 2023. In 2026, he joined Spanish club Barcelona.
Brian Fariñas Pérez (born 9 February 2006) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona.

Daniel Olmo Carvajal (born 7 May 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team. After a period at La Masia, Olmo made his professional debut for Dinamo Zagreb in Croatia in 2015.

Dominik Livaković (Croatian pronunciation: ; born 9 January 1995) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Barcelona and the Croatia national team. Livaković has spent the bulk of his career with NK Zagreb, being the club's youth product, and with Dinamo Zagreb. Internationally, Livaković has represented Croatia since 2017, a product of their youth academy.

Eric García Martret (born 9 January 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer from Catalonia who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team. García moved from Barcelona at the age of 17 to Manchester City. He made his Premier League debut on 21 September 2019. In his final season at the club, he won the league and was runner-up in the UEFA Champions League.
Fermín López Marín (born 11 May 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.

Frenkie de Jong (born 12 May 1997) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Netherlands national team. A versatile midfielder, he is known for his vision, passing, dribbling, technique, along with strong defensive abilities and attacking prowess. De Jong has frequently been ranked among the best midfielders in world football.

Gabriel Fernando de Jesus (born 3 April 1997) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for La Liga club Barcelona. Jesus began his senior club career at Palmeiras, where he was voted Best Newcomer at the 2015 Campeonato Brasileiro Série A and finished first in the Copa do Brasil.

Pablo Martín Páez Gavira (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 5 August 2004), known as Gavi (pronounced ), is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team. In 2022, he won the Golden Boy award and received the Kopa Trophy, awarded by France Football during the 2022 Ballon d'Or ceremony.
Gerard Martín Langreo (born 26 February 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for La Liga club Barcelona.

Hamza Mohamed Abdelkarim Selim (Arabic: حمزة محمد عبد الكريم سليم; born 1 January 2008) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Barcelona and the Egypt national team.

Hans-Dieter "Hansi" Flick (German pronunciation: ; born 24 February 1965) is a German professional football manager and former player who is the manager of La Liga club Barcelona. Flick played for SV Sandhausen, Bayern Munich, and 1. FC Köln during his career as a footballer. He began his managerial career as player-manager of fourth-division club Victoria Bammental.
Jesse Eugen K. Bisiwu (born 22 January 2008) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for La Liga club Barcelona.

Joan Garcia Pons (Catalan: ; born 4 May 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team. An Espanyol youth graduate, Garcia broke into the first team in 2021 and eventually established himself as a first-choice in 2024. In June 2025, he moved to Barcelona after the club activated his release clause.

João Pedro Cavaco Cancelo (born 27 May 1994) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a right-back or left-back for La Liga club Barcelona and the Portugal national team. After coming through Benfica's youth academy, Cancelo began playing for the club's reserve team in 2012 and was promoted to the first team two years later.
Jules Olivier Koundé (born 12 November 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defender for Spanish La Liga club FC Barcelona

Karim David Adeyemi (/kəˈriːm/ kuh-REEM /ˌɑːdɛˈjɛmi/ ah-deh-YEH-mee; born 18 January 2002) is a German professional footballer who plays as a right winger or forward for La Liga club Barcelona and the Germany national team.

Lamine Yamal Nasraoui Ebana (born 13 July 2007), commonly known as Lamine Yamal, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right winger for the La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team. Widely regarded as one of the best players in the world, he is known for his dribbling and playmaking ability.
Marc Bernal Casas (born 26 May 2007) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona.

Pau Cubarsí Paredes (born 22 January 2007) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team. He is considered one of the best young defenders in the world.

Pedro González López (born 25 November 2002), more commonly known as Pedri, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team. He is regarded as one of the best midfielders in the world.

Raphael Dias Belloli (Portuguese pronunciation: ; born 14 December 1996), known as Raphinha, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for La Liga club Barcelona and the Brazil national team. Known for his pace, playmaking, work rate, and finishing, he is considered one of the best players in the world.

Rodrigo Hernández Cascante (born 22 June 1996), known simply as Rodri or Rodrigo, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and captains the Spain national team. Widely regarded as one of the best midfielders in the world, he is known for his passing, composure, playmaking and physical attributes.
Roony Bardghji is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger for La Liga club Barcelona. Born in Kuwait, he plays for the Sweden national team.

Wojciech Tomasz Szczęsny (Polish pronunciation: ⓘ; born 18 April 1990) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Barcelona. Known for his reflexes and shot stopping, Szczęsny is widely regarded as one of the best goalkeepers in the world.
Xavi Espart Font (born 21 May 2007) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back or defensive midfielder for Barcelona Atlètic.
